sentences.text:
2. Heard counsel for petitioners as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.
3.

Taking into consideration the fact that the allegation made in the FIR is in respect of preparation of a forged document of sale in the name of one Sita Devi Mittal; in other cases of similar nature,
petitioners have already been released on bail by the Coordinate Benchs of this Court, granting benefit of proviso to Section 480 of BNSS, 2023; petitioners are in custody since their time of arrest in the present case and offences are triable by Magistrate, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioners on bail.
4.

Accordingly, all three bail applications are allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioners - Smt. Bhanwari Devi W/o Shri Omprakash & Smt Sarita Dalmiya W/o Shri Shiv Gopal Dalmiya shall be released on bail provided they furnish a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- each with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for their appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(SUDESH BANSAL),J RONAK JAIMAN/156-158 (Uploaded on 06/12/2025 at 12:27:48 PM)
